forecast.scope: est. · the app’s same-hour cached forecast/model inputs; not measurements inferred from the camera image

limitations: The camera operator supplies no verified exposure timestamp, bearing, lens calibration or camera height.
Fetch time is the comparison clock; it is not proof of the camera exposure time.
Lens glare, weather on the lens and automatic exposure can prevent a meaningful color comparison.
The original camera photo is unretouched and is never used in the rendered scene.
Forecast inputs are est. model values at the reference request midpoint, not observed camera conditions.
The approved Inlet app camera is unchanged. Camera height, heading, crop and optics are not a calibrated match.
Nighttime reference cannot establish daylight water, foam or sand color.
